images.prompt: Generate one transparent game UI asset, PNG RGBA with REAL alpha outside the object. No colored background, no black background, no checkerboard pattern. It will be placed over existing card artwork. Kalistar hand-painted fantasy game. A single SOLID irregular round flat piece of dark basalt rock with a thick faceted chipped perimeter. Front-facing stone stat capsule, roughly square overall silhouette, not a hollow ring. 65 percent of the central area is opaque dark quiet rock reserved for readable white stat text to be added later; no text in this asset. Pale icy blue-white magic glows softly from sparse cracks along the outer edges only, slight outward magical wisps. Avoid a perfect circular metallic rim, avoid an arrangement of separate stones. One piece of stone, almost like a palm-sized heavy shield-shaped slab with angular edges, but no straps. Large deliberate painted facets and brushwork, restrained fine detail, readable at 75px. Full object entirely in view, centered with transparent margin on all four sides, square canvas. RGBA alpha is essential; transparent exterior and opaque stone center.
